# Avatar

Rounded-tile avatar for people, the AI assistant, Aleem himself, and the admissions case-study mascot.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Avatar` · Core

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Avatar />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Avatar"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Rounded-tile avatar. Defaults to the dark Aleem mascot so the assistant reads consistently; also supports photos (`kind="image"`) and initials. A photo that fails to load falls back to initials automatically.

## Props (AvatarProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | Image URL (used when kind is "image"). |
| `name` | `string` | Name, drives initials fallback and alt text. |
| `kind` | `'aiux' \| 'assistant' \| 'cory' \| 'cory-light' \| 'image' \| 'initials'` | What to render. aiux: the AIUX logo tile (Aleem himself). assistant: a neutral AI spark on the brand gradient. cory / cory-light: the admissions case-study m… |
| `size` | `number \| string` | Pixel size (square). @default 40 |
| `ring` | `boolean` | Add a subtle separating ring. @default false |
| `status` | `'online' \| 'away' \| 'busy' \| 'offline'` | Presence dot at the corner. |
| `statusLabel` | `string` | Accessible text for the dot. @default status |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>._
